description_en: Queries the AD account information obtained after an AD office network (formerly workspace) is connected to an AD domain
description_zh: 查询AD办公网络（原工作区）对接AD域后获取的AD账号信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecd list-office-site-users --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-3633530000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOfficeSiteUsers

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The office network ID. Only office networks based on enterprise AD accounts are supported
parameters.help_zh: 办公网络ID。仅支持基于企业AD账号的办公网络
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Leave this parameter empty for the first request or if no more results exist. If more results exist, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.    

Maximum value: 100.    
Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。    

最大值：100。    
默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The specified AD domain organizational unit (OU)
parameters.name: ou_path

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not publicly available. You can only pass in `1` or leave it empty
parameters.help_zh: 该字段未开放使用。只能传入`1`或者不传入任何值
parameters.name: assigned_info

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return only users who are assigned cloud computers
parameters.help_zh: 是否只返回分配云电脑的用户
parameters.name: include_assigned_user

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next query. An empty value indicates that no more results exist
NextToken.description_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个

Users.description_en: The array of AD account usernames. If the enterprise AD contains only the Administrator and Guest users and no other users, an empty Users array is returned
Users.description_zh:
AD账号用户名组成的数组。    
如果企业AD中的用户只有Administrator和Guest，没有其他用户，则将返回空的Users数组

items.description_en: The username of the AD account

AssignedDesktopNumber.description_en: The number of assigned cloud computers

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the AD account

DisplayNameNew.description_en: The new display name of the user

EndUser.description_en: The username of the AD account
